180s turn timeout, 2/project and 6/global limits; cooldown admits no call at 59s and attempt 4 at 60s; 300s boundary; operator_retry requires a non-empty actor, retires the episode and opens a replacement. Independent review PASS.

One durable retry row + stable escalation_event_id; pending_escalations is a projection, one item across ten reads and one log line per loop. A RUNNING/WAITING_EXTERNAL node over 30 simulated days has stalled_rounds==0, zero model calls, no episode, and preserved scientific evidence. Independent review PASS.
